# OpenLaunch SDK

> Open-source TypeScript SDK for spaceflight data, astrodynamics, mission analysis and spacecraft engineering.

## Start here
- README.md — package overview and API guide
- examples/README.md — categorized cookbook with self-contained examples
- examples/catalog.json — machine-readable example metadata
- examples/AI_INDEX.md — AI-oriented usage rules, units and modeling assumptions
- docs/EXPORTS.md — public export inventory
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — SDK architecture
- docs/PROVIDERS.md — LL2, NASA and CelesTrak provider notes
- docs/VALIDATION.md — validation boundaries

## Canonical source
- src/index.ts — root public exports
- src/client.ts — OpenLaunch client and provider/resource wiring
- src/providers/ — LL2/NASA/CelesTrak integrations
- src/resources/ — high-level and raw resources
- src/science/ — deterministic engineering and math helpers

## Examples by task
- examples/00-getting-started/ — client basics
- examples/01-launch-library/ — LL2 launch/agency/astronaut/event/pad/raw/config use
- examples/02-nasa/ — NASA Open APIs
- examples/03-celestrak/ — OMM/catalog access
- examples/04-orbital-mechanics/ — orbital and transfer calculations
- examples/05-rocket-engineering/ — rocket equation, staging and delta-v
- examples/06-spacecraft-engineering/ — power, RF, thermal, structures, reliability, life support, data and radiation
- examples/07-gnc-math/ — vectors, matrices, quaternions, PID, Kalman and numerics
- examples/08-geodesy-visibility/ — WGS84, ECEF/ECI and visibility
- examples/09-atmosphere-edl/ — atmosphere, aerodynamics and entry/descent helpers
- examples/10-astronomy-time-units/ — unit conversion, Julian/sidereal time and astronomy
- examples/11-integrated-missions/ — multi-module architecture examples
- examples/12-sdk-infrastructure/ — cache and telemetry patterns

## Important limitations
OpenLaunch is not flight-qualified software. Do not treat two-body propagation as SGP4/high-fidelity orbit propagation, or preliminary mission/EDL/RF/thermal calculations as certified operational products. Validate independently for safety-critical use.
